original_test_intent: Verify the active UBB/baseboard FPGA image on the intended GPU assembly is the version approved by the project release package.
original_method: Through a trusted read-only Redfish session, retrieve ubb_fpga_active, bind its member fields to the physical UBB FPGA, and compare the active version to the authoritative release reference with redacted audit evidence.
manual_activity: Engineering/security approves the BMC and UBB component map, supplies the release target and owns final discrepancy disposition.
required_inputs: Trusted BMC endpoint/certificate and network route
Physical UBB FPGA to ubb_fpga_active mapping
Response redaction, access audit and evidence retention policy
safety_requirements: Verify endpoint and certificate before authentication
Restrict request and privileges to inventory read
Confirm resource maps to the physical UBB rather than SMC FPGA
agent_execution_scope: GET only the approved UBB FPGA member
Compare against the supplied release baseline
Do not broaden access, bypass TLS, update firmware or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve BMC trust and UBB resource mapping
Supply expected version and release authority
Resolve mismatch/security/schema issues and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Broad inventory over unverified transport cannot distinguish ubb_fpga_active from amc_fpga_active and exposes secrets.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retrieve exact ubb_fpga_active over verified HTTPS with brokered read-only credentials and compare its active version to the approved release entry.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: UBB FPGA active-image scope, release-note check and source 5/5 timing are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Persist a single component assertion tying verified BMC, UBB physical identifier, Redfish member, active state/version and release reference.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Prevents SMC/UBB FPGA cross-match and secures the query.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: SMC FPGA evidence is explicitly excluded from this baseboard checkpoint.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Equal version strings across boards remain possible, making physical/resource identity mandatory.

project_override_considerations: A secure vendor utility may replace Redfish only if it uniquely binds the active UBB FPGA and same release reference; firmware update is out of scope.
expected_evidence: Verified BMC/TLS identity and service version
Approved read-only role without secret material
Exact ubb_fpga_active URI/status/time and redacted component fields
Physical UBB mapping, active flag and version
BMC access audit/security notes and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item and exact ubb_fpga_active path consistently identify UBB FPGA firmware; adjacent SMC FPGA similarity is resolved by the explicit member map.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Trusted access, resource mapping and expected version can be supplied; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Makes UBB physical/resource identity a first-class oracle and secures/redacts the otherwise broad management inventory access.
independent_technical_reasoning: An FPGA version is not globally unique: the SMC and UBB may both expose FPGA members and even share version formatting. The pass condition must bind the active image to the UBB resource and physical assembly. Verified transport ensures the inventory itself belongs to the intended baseboard manager.
